verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events, and suggests hypotheses, so telemetry-based probable-cause investigation is a first-party capability. However, the evidence shows the agent being called on demand (tagging @betterstack, calling it from Slack, Teams, or LLM workflows), not starting an investigation before a human asks. Nothing in the evidence covers correlating changes or deploys, or matching similar past incidents. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic/proactive investigation on incident trigger, correlation with recent changes/deploys, similar-past-incident matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
Discussing an incident in Slack? Call the AI SRE simply by tagging @betterstack.
